faq_heading: Homes near Tamanawis Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Tamanawis Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Tamanawis Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Tamanawis Secondary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Tamanawis Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 312 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,245,000, townhomes $727,500, condos $475,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Tamanawis Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Tamanawis Secondary the median was 32 days on the market, closing at 96.6% of the list price, with 10% of sales above the list price for the 312 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Tamanawis Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Martha Jane Norris Elementary (0.6 km east), Beaver Creek Elementary (0.6 km west) and Boundary Park Elementary (0.9 km south-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Tamanawis Secondary

29 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Tamanawis Secondary in a straight line (23 elementary, 4 secondary, 2 other; 6 independent). The closest is Martha Jane Norris Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Jarvis Traditional Elementary, 2.7 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Princess Margaret Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (0.9 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (1.3 km). Other secondary schools close by: Princess Margaret Secondary (1.3 km north-east), Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (1.3 km east), iLearn Secondary School Society (2.1 km east), Seaquam Secondary (2.2 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Princess Margaret Secondary, 1.3 km north-east of Tamanawis Secondary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Tamanawis Secondary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Tamanawis Secondary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Tamanawis Secondary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.

Compare price with similar homes farther from the school. The median house within 2 km of Tamanawis Secondary was $1,245,000, so check whether size and age explain a gap before you pay for the location.
Look at Princess Margaret Secondary, the nearest other secondary school, 1.3 km north-east of Tamanawis Secondary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
